context: Grand Central, the information booth under the clock. Evening rush.

lines.speaker: char.walter_feeney
lines.text: Track twenty-nine. Next. Oh. You're not asking about a train.

lines.speaker: char.walter_feeney
lines.text: Thursdays, five-forty, a woman says good night to me across the arches. Eleven years.

lines.speaker: char.walter_feeney
lines.text: I've never seen her face. That was the arrangement. Three Thursdays now, nothing.

lines.speaker: char.walter_feeney
lines.text: She mentioned a switchboard once. And a cane she hated. That's all I have.
